test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from passive voice to active voice:

A solution has been proposed by the committee to address the problem.

options.text: The committee had proposed a solution to address the problem.
The committee was proposing a solution to address the problem.
The committee proposed a solution to address the problem.
The committee has proposed a solution to address the problem.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• The original sentence is in passive voice: "A solution has been proposed by the committee to address the problem."
 
• In the active voice, the subject "the committee" takes the action.
 
• The correct active voice structure is: "The committee has proposed a solution to address the problem."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The committee has proposed a solution to address the problem."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The committee had proposed a solution to address the problem." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"The committee was proposing a solution to address the problem." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"The committee proposed a solution to address the problem." – Incorrect tense (simple past).
 
• **Option 4: **"The committee has proposed a solution to address the problem." – Correct tense (present perfect).
